decisions.reason: Because it is a sensing module closely related to existing hardware and its move to a dedicated page signals that the firm can interpret and build on early results.
Because it directly extends the firm's power input modules, has had its own page since launch, and sits well within the firm's existing R&D and manufacturing knowledge.
Although it is close to existing power-switching modules, its continued low website presence suggests weaker traction, but the firm's related knowledge still supports learning and improvement.
It builds on the firm's established I/O and control capabilities, so even with limited early results the firm can assimilate feedback and improve the module.

It fits the strategic charging and energy-management direction but requires newer service and connectivity capabilities, so its absorptive capacity is lower and early demand signals need careful interpretation.
